Class KfeTreasuryPlanningService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.KfeTreasuryPlanningService
@Service @EnableConfigurationProperties(KfeTreasuryProperties.class) public class KfeTreasuryPlanningService extends Object
